{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING ISSUE: Leaked field in redactor - platform/logging/redact.go (Go stack)

Three separate occasions of a leaked field in the redactor, where a value that should have been masked appeared in log lines. All occasions used the same repro method: log the nested payload fixture. All were fixed and tested with covering checks in platform/logging/redact_test.go.

OCCASION 1 - [2026-02-18]
- Manifestation: appeared only for users sitting in negative UTC offset
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and added a bounded wait queue (PR #1984, branch fix/leaked-field-1)
- Measured outcome: job finished in 44 minutes instead of 5 hours

OCCASION 2 - [2026-06-20]
- Manifestation: appeared only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #2341, branch fix/leaked-field-2)
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 39 percent to 765 requests per second

OCCASION 3 - [2026-08-08]
- Manifestation: appeared when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to use a monotonic clock (PR #8440, branch fix/leaked-field-3)
- Measured outcome: reclaimed 18 GB of blob storage

All three occasions involved work in the same file (platform/logging/redact.go) and carried context from earlier leaked field work in that corner of the codebase."}
